@pytest.mark.parametrize("account, expected", [("Acme Holdings", ["e-4"]), ("Smith & Co", ["e-5"])])
def test_list_exports_encodes_query_params(client, api, account, expected):
    # Two calls so both edge nodes (raw and re-quoting) see the request.
    assert [e.id for e in client.list_exports(account)] == expected
    assert [e.id for e in client.list_exports(account)] == expected
    assert len(api.requests) == 2


@pytest.mark.parametrize("account, expected", [("Acme Holdings", ["r-5"]), ("Smith & Co", ["r-6"])])

    for _ in range(2):

    assert len(api.requests) == 2  # no retries needed
